subject: Quantitative Ability
q: Usman spends 1/5 of his salary on rent and 1/6 of the remainder on food. If he is left with Rs 180,000, what is his salary?
explanation: After spending 1/5, 4/5 is left; after 1/6 of that, 4/5 × 5/6 = 2/3 of the whole = 180,000, so the whole = 270,000.

subject: Quantitative Ability
q: A girl gave 1/6 of her pocket money to charity and spent 1/6 of the rest on books. She had Rs 8,750 left. How much pocket money did she have?
explanation: After spending 1/6, 5/6 is left; after 1/6 of that, 5/6 × 5/6 = 25/36 of the whole = 8,750, so the whole = 12,600.

subject: Quantitative Ability
q: A farmer sold 1/4 of his wheat and then 1/5 of what remained, and still had 204 maunds. How much wheat did he have at first?
explanation: After spending 1/4, 3/4 is left; after 1/5 of that, 3/4 × 4/5 = 3/5 of the whole = 204, so the whole = 340.

subject: Quantitative Ability
q: 1/6 of a rope was used for a tent and then 1/4 of the remaining piece for a swing, leaving 390 m. How long was the rope?
explanation: After spending 1/6, 5/6 is left; after 1/4 of that, 5/6 × 3/4 = 5/8 of the whole = 390, so the whole = 624.

subject: Quantitative Ability
q: Kiran spends 2/7 of her income on food and 1/2 on rent, and saves Rs 54,000. What is her income?
explanation: Remaining part = 1 − 2/7 − 1/2 = 3/14; 3/14 of the whole = 54000, so the whole = 252,000.

subject: Quantitative Ability
q: In a school, 3/5 of the students walk to school, 1/4 come by bus and the remaining 420 come by car. How many students are there?
explanation: Remaining part = 1 − 3/5 − 1/4 = 3/20; 3/20 of the whole = 420, so the whole = 2,800.

subject: Quantitative Ability
q: Of the trees in an orchard, 4/7 are mango, 2/7 are guava, and the remaining 12 are citrus. How many trees are there in the orchard?
explanation: Remaining part = 1 − 4/7 − 2/7 = 1/7; 1/7 of the whole = 12, so the whole = 84.

subject: Quantitative Ability
q: 1/5 of a journey is made by train, 3/7 by bus and the remaining 195 km on foot. How long is the whole journey?
explanation: Remaining part = 1 − 1/5 − 3/7 = 13/35; 13/35 of the whole = 195, so the whole = 525.
